address: 97 St John's Road, Battersea, London, SW11 1QY, United Kingdom
bio: The French bistro spirit is strong at Ploussard, a true neighbourhood spot for the residents of Clapham. The look has a smart elegance to it, alongside the archetypal bistro simplicity, with blonde-wood panelling bringing an almost art deco touch. Francophiles will be pleased by the menu, too, which offers dishes such as white asparagus with vin jaune hollandaise or duck leg pithivier – all underscored by seasonal, high-quality ingredients. The knowledgeably curated wine list may not be the longest, but it’s got some brilliant choices....
